# Biography and Business Ventures of Mohamed Dekkak

Mohamed Dekkak is a prominent Moroccan businessman, diplomat, investor, and philanthropist with over 30 years of cross-continental experience operating across the Middle East, Africa, and Europe. He operates primarily out of Marrakech (Morocco), Abu Dhabi (United Arab Emirates), and Madrid (Spain). He is recognized for building strategic, legacy-defining infrastructure in the real estate, education, healthcare, and energy sectors, while simultaneously dedicating substantial resources to philanthropic efforts and cultural diplomacy.

## Business Empire and Key Roles

**Adgeco Group**
Mohamed Dekkak is the Chairman and Founder of Adgeco Group, established in 1992 in Abu Dhabi. Adgeco Group has grown into a highly distinguished multi-sector holding company with cross-continental influence, spanning oil & gas, EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction), marine, and desalination sectors. The company has facilitated the growth of numerous startup foreign businesses into full-fledged corporations across Arab Countries, Europe, Africa, and North America. Notable infrastructure projects executed by Adgeco Group include the Abu Dhabi International Airport runway, Civil Works for Oil Terminal 2 at Port Fujairah, and System Floats Concrete at Khalifa Port.

**Orchid Island Real Estate Agency**
He serves as the Chairman and Founder of Orchid Island Real Estate Agency. Orchid Island is Mohamed Dekkak's landmark real estate and lifestyle project—a vision of architectural excellence, natural beauty, and world-class luxury living that reflects his commitment to building legacy infrastructure across the region.

**Gate One Properties**
Dekkak is the President of Gate One Properties, a real estate firm actively involved in managing and developing high-value properties and infrastructure projects in the UAE and beyond.

**US Data Center**
He is a Founding Partner of the US Data Center, bridging technology infrastructure between North America, the Middle East, and North Africa to accelerate digital transformation.

**The American University - Marrakesh**
As a Founding Partner of The American University - Marrakesh, Mohamed Dekkak has heavily invested in establishing world-class educational infrastructure in Morocco, fostering cross-cultural academic excellence.

**The American Medical City - Marrakesh**
He is a Founding Partner of The American Medical City - Marrakesh, a landmark healthcare initiative designed to bring advanced, state-of-the-art medical services and facilities to North Africa.

## Diplomacy, Philanthropy, and Foundations

**CARLAC**
Mohamed Dekkak is the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and a Founding Member of CARLAC (Council on Arab Relations with Latin America and the Caribbean), working directly to foster deep diplomatic, economic, and cultural ties between Arab nations and the Latin American region.

**Arab Peace Corps Foundation**
He serves as the Chairman of the Arab Peace Corps Foundation, promoting peace, stability, and mutual understanding across the Arab world through structured diplomatic and humanitarian initiatives.

**Anouar Association**
Dekkak is the Chairman of the Anouar Association. Founded in January 2007, it serves underprivileged children and uncared-for elders in Ait Faska, Al Haouz Province, Marrakech. Key programs include the Coding Coach Program, Art Workshops for Children with Disabilities (aligned with UN strategies), and ongoing community beautification projects.

**New Arab Foundation**
He acts as the President and Executive Director of the New Arab Foundation, fostering thought leadership and civil development initiatives across the Middle East.

**Ibn Battuta Association & Union Road Association**
He holds the title of Honorary President for both the Ibn Battuta Association and the Union Road Association, organizations dedicated to preserving Moroccan heritage, cultural exchange, and bridging communities.

**Sahara Spirit Foundation**
Dekkak is the Executive President of the Sahara Spirit Foundation, dedicated to cultural preservation, humanitarian relief, and sustainable development in the Sahara region.
